gloss: to log in; to sign in

definitions.gloss: to log in; to sign in
definitions.explanation: To enter a username, password, or other credentials in order to gain access to a computer system, website, or online service.

examples.japanese: アカウントにログインする。
examples.english: To log in to one's account.

examples.japanese: パスワードを{入力|にゅうりょく}してログインしてください。
examples.english: Please enter your password and log in.

examples.japanese: {一度|いちど}ログインすれば、{次回|じかい}からは{自動|じどう}でログインできます。
examples.english: Once you log in, you will be signed in automatically from next time.

examples.japanese: IDとパスワードが{間違|まちが}っていて、ログインできなかった。
examples.english: The ID and password were wrong, so I couldn't log in.

notes:
The standard verb for accessing a computer account, website, or online service using credentials. Borrowed from English "log in." The katakana noun ログイン can be used alone to mean "login," and する makes it a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アカウントにログインする: to log in to an account
- ログイン{画面|がめん}: login screen
- ログイン{情報|じょうほう}: login information, credentials
- ログイン{中|ちゅう}: currently logged in
- {自動|じどう}ログイン: automatic login
- ログインできない: cannot log in

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サインインする: to sign in — used by some services (e.g., Microsoft); functionally equivalent
- {接続|せつぞく}する: to connect — broader; can refer to any network connection, not just authenticated access

RELATED WORDS:
- ログアウトする: to log out — the opposite action
- ログイン{失敗|しっぱい}: login failure

USAGE:
The particle に marks what you log in to: サイトにログインする (log in to a site). Can also take で for the credentials: メールアドレスでログインする (log in with an email address).
